name: Scroll of Myzrael
summary: The Scroll of Myzrael is used to summon Myzrael at the Shards of Myzrael in the Arathi Highlands. Its use is tied to the effort to bind her again.

sections.title: At the Shards
sections.body: At the Shards of Myzrael in the Arathi Highlands, the scroll calls forth the being held beneath them. Myzrael must be defeated, and her Eldritch Shackles bound to the shards. The work is meant to keep her captive as her power grows.

faq.q: What does the Scroll of Myzrael do?
faq.answer: The Scroll of Myzrael is used to summon Myzrael at the Shards of Myzrael in the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Where do I use the scroll?
faq.answer: The scroll is used at the Shards of Myzrael in the Arathi Highlands, where Myzrael was first encountered.
Myzrael must be defeated before her power grows, then bound again at the shards with her Eldritch Shackles.

faq.q: What are the Eldritch Shackles for?
faq.answer: The Eldritch Shackles are bound to the Shards of Myzrael to trap her again.
